content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Applications Special cases Re-enrolling after stopping your studies Re-enrolling after stopping your studies Do you wish to continue the study programme which you started at HTW Berlin but decided to stop for whatever reason? If so, send a re-enrolment request to the Student Services Department within the regular application deadlines . In this signed request, please provide your personal details including your current address, email address and information about the study programme. You also need to confirm that you have not been enrolled at any other university during your absence from HTW Berlin.
